reason: The README clearly documents a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is browser automation through Chromium, including navigation, interaction, page extraction, tab management, downloads, uploads, screenshots, and PDFs; these network and file capabilities warrant elevated risk classification.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Chromium 的浏览器自动化工具，可导航网页、交互表单、读取页面、管理标签页并处理下载、上传及截图等内容。
summaries.en: Provides Chromium-based browser automation for DeepSeek Harness, including webpage navigation, form interaction, page reading, tab management, downloads, uploads, screenshots, and PDFs.

capabilities: Navigate public HTTP and HTTPS websites
Click elements and fill form fields
Read page text and accessibility snapshots
Manage browser tabs and background loads
Capture screenshots and PDFs
Download browser resources to a configured artifact directory
Upload files from a configured upload directory
Optionally persist cookies and local storage
Use configured browser proxies and external network access
